plan.major: Advanced Proficiency in English as a Second Language
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Advanced Proficiency in English as a Second Language Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 12, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7694/PublishedPdf). Total Units: 12; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path = 3 + 6 + 3 = 12 units in a single semester. Semester sum verified against the map's 12 Units header. Certificate of Achievement requires a grade of 'C' or better in each major course. No choice slots. Documented prereqs (prior coursework, not in-plan): ESL 114 requires any two of ESLG 51, ESLL 51, or ESL 55; ESL 325 requires ESL 315 with a grade of 'C' or better, or placement through the assessment process; ESLG 320 requires ESLG 310 with a grade of 'C' or better, or, for students not previously enrolled in ESL courses within the Los Rios district, placement through the Los Rios assessment process. No GE pattern (certificate of achievement, major-only path). Arts & Communication Meta Majors. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
